title: AI治理、绿色基础设施与Agent安全沙盒驱动云计算结构性变革
core_insight: AI治理框架与物理AI基础设施投资成为核心驱动力，同时云厂商在AI Agent安全执行环境和碳效率方面取得突破，标志云计算向规模化安全部署和绿色分布式智能加速转型

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出S3 Files将对象存储作为高性能文件系统访问；Cloudflare通过Dynamic Workers实现AI生成代码安全沙盒执行，性能提升100倍；Google Cloud发布Envoy在智能体AI时代的网络基础架构分析 Amazon ECS Managed Daemons支持平台工程师独立控制监控代理；Azure推进数据库与AI融合；Cloudflare优化Kubernetes卷权限处理提升重启效率 Launching S3 Files, making S3 buckets accessible as file systems Sandboxing AI agents, 100x faster Envoy: A future-ready foundation for agentic AI networking Announcing managed daemon support for Amazon ECS Managed Instances A one-line Kubernetes fix that saved 600 hours a year Advancing agentic AI with Microsoft databases across a unified data estate
